_note: A LapEE tunnel broker that meters the traffic it carries, charges a renewable recharging ledger, and publishes a location record. Replace the location URL and economic policy before deployment.
_note-metering: metering@1.0 prices the ETF-encoded bodies P4 supplies. One ledger unit per measured byte is monotone but is not wire-octet billing; calibrate it against observed traffic.
_note-ledger: Each account starts with a 25 MB trial bucket and no baseline refill. The router grants the larger entitlement: 1,000 units/s per whole AO held, or per 1% share of the latest AO mint. This is renewable token-gated quota, not settlement to the operator. Ledger state is intentionally broker-local and resets when its HyperBEAM VM restarts.
_note-location: The signed location record is permanent. The POST/self/commit-request hook refreshes it through the explicit production ANS-104 bundler.
_note-hooks: p4@1.0 must precede tunnel@1.0 in on/request. The tunnel response hook must return ok after accepting a payload so P4's response hook can collect the measured response-byte charge.
_note-billing: Canonical tunnel commit 49d5fa8 still halts the response-hook chain after accepting /~tunnel@1.0/response, so served payloads bill flat. The review branch fix/response-hook-continuation changes that one successful return to ok; replace the tunnel implementation pin after that branch is reviewed and permanently published.
